| `pai worker providers update` | Change a provider's cost tier and tags |
| `pai worker providers use` | Make a provider the active one |
| `pai worker proxy` | The local proxy for OpenAI-style providers |
| `pai worker ps` | List this session's workers, running and finished |
| `pai worker queue` | Show or reorder the workers waiting for a provider slot |
| `pai worker replay` | Print the transcript of one worker |
| `pai worker resume` | Continue a finished worker with a new instruction |
| `pai worker roles` | Old name of `classes` |
| `pai worker roles list` | List classes and where each one runs |
| `pai worker roles set` | Send a class to a provider, or give it routing limits |
| `pai worker roles unset` | Remove a class (runs then use the active provider) |
| `pai worker run` | Run one task on a worker (another provider or model) |
| `pai worker say` | Send a message to a running worker |
| `pai worker status-line` | One-line worker summary for a status bar |
| `pai worker test-run` | Run a test command; when it goes silent, say where it is stuck |
| `pai worker usage` | Token totals per provider and model for a set of workers |
| `pai worker verify` | Check that a worker's changes are already in your checkout |
| `pai worker wait` | Wait for child workers; returns when any finishes or --max elapses |
| `pai worker wait-file` | Wait for files to appear |
| `pai worker wait-on` | Wait for a background job to finish |
| `pai worker wait-url` | Wait for a server to answer HTTP |
| `pai worker watch` | Worker list that refreshes every 2 seconds |
| `pai zettel` | Explore the links between your notes |
| `pai zettel converse` | Ask the vault a question |
| `pai zettel explore` | Follow link chains from a note |
| `pai zettel health` | Check the vault for dead links and orphans |
| `pai zettel suggest` | Suggest new links for a note |
| `pai zettel surprise` | Find notes that are alike in meaning but far apart in links |
| `pai zettel themes` | Spot topics emerging in recent notes |
